2124936278043185632.en_summary: Posts a few thoughts on what seen and heard at the @TomorrowXSummit: cautious and bearish views on the AI trade abounded among institutional investors. Two weighty bear arguments: recent $ANT inference revenue suggests fewer GW of compute needed, and slowdown in frontier lab ARR growth. Discusses counterarguments on compute needs, ARR composition, open-weight growth, adoption curves, commitments, historical capex booms. Optimism on LLM progress, RSI next year, robotics in 2027. Concludes much negativity from price action rationalization.
2124936278043185632.zh_summary: 發帖關於在 @TomorrowXSummit 看到和聽到的一些想法：機構投資者中對 AI 交易的謹慎和看跌觀點很多。兩個有分量的看跌論點：最近 $ANT 推理收入表明需要更少的 GW 計算，以及前沿實驗室 ARR 增長放緩。討論對計算需求、ARR 組成、開放權重增長、採用曲線、承諾、歷史資本支出熱潮的反論點。對 LLM 進展、明年 RSI、2027 年機器人的樂觀。結論很多負面來自價格行動的事後合理化。
